messages:
samir: Quick heads-up — after the routing policy push this morning we got a handful of customer reports where they only see a generic 429 with no guidance. Can we align on a consistent error shape that includes routing + quota hints? :eyes:

maya: Seen it. Customer says they couldn't tell if it was a per-user quota, per-route throttle, or our fallback kicking in. They retried the same request rather than switching config.

eli: Agree we should be explicit. Proposal: error payload contains `code`, `message`, `retry_after` (seconds), and a `hints` array. Additionally, ship routing metadata under `x-redwood-routing` header and a small `routing` object in the body: policy and fallback used.

grace: +1. Also want the console to surface "fallback_rate" per route so SRE/product can see which customers are being routed off. We currently only have infra logs — not surfaced to per-customer dashboards.

alex: Quick sketch of response shape I'm suggesting (for 429/503):

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-Routing: policy=cost_prefer;fallback=gpt-small-v1
X-Client-Quota: route=text-gen;limit=1000;period=3600

{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limit.exceeded",
    "message": "Rate limit exceeded for route 'text-generation'.",
    "retry_after": 32,
    "hints": ["Consider reducing tokens_per_request","Pin to Dedicated for predictable throughput"]
  },
  "routing": {
    "policy": "cost_prefer",
    "fallback": "gpt-small-v1",
    "fallback_reason": "capacity_burst"
  }
}
```

maya: Love the headers. Can we make the header keys stable and documented in the API reference? e.g. `X-Redwood-Routing` and `X-Client-Quota`. Also add `x-retry-after-ms` for client libraries that prefer ms.

samir: Yes — doc + SDK mapping. Also need to agree on `code` values. We already have `quota_exceeded` and `rate_limit.exceeded` floating around. Can we centralize into taxonomy: `client.quota`, `client.rate_limit`, `routing.fallback`, `service.degraded`, `service.unavailable`?

eli: That taxonomy looks good. Suggest prefixing with domain so telemetry/routing rules can filter easily: `client.quota`, `client.rate_limit`, `routing.fallback`, `infra.throttle`. Keep human readable message separate.

deploy-bot: Deploy v12 routing-policy change completed in eu-west-1 :white_check_mark:

maya: After a quick chat with support, customers want a link in the message to a KB article (short id), not a full URL. Could add `kb_id` in error body, e.g. `kb: "KB-1372"` which console can link to.

grace: For dashboards: new metrics to add:
- api.fallback_rate by route, region, policy
- api.error_code_count.{code} (tagged by customer)
- api.retry_after_distribution (p95)

We should also surface suggestion frequency from Optimize (e.g., how often we recommended pinning to Dedicated) as a hint alongside fallback_rate.

alex: One UX note: in Console route details, when a fallback is active we should show an inline banner: "This route is currently operating in fallback mode (cost_prefer -> gpt-small-v1). Learn more [KB-1372]" so product and customers see it immediately.

samir: Implementation plan: (1) finalize taxonomy + codes (samir/eli), (2) update runtime to emit headers + body routing block (eng-runtime), (3) telemetry folks add metrics (grace), (4) docs + SDK mapping (maya), (5) console banner + per-customer fallback panel (alex), (6) QA + canary in eu-west (qa-bot). Can we have owners for each?

eli: I'll own the taxonomy + runtime contract with samir.

grace: I'll own telemetry dashboards and add `api.fallback_rate` + `api.error_code_count` panels.

maya: Docs + SDK mapping on me. Will add header reference and example responses.

alex: Console banner + route UI changes — I'll take it.

qa-bot: I'll run a canary suite that validates headers, error body fields, and console event ingestion.

samir: One final ask — make the error shape compact for edge clients. Keep `routing` and `error` but avoid deeply nested extras. We can add a `debug_id` for correlating logs.

eli: Good call. Add `debug_id` string (UUID) and ensure it's logged in request traces. Telemetry will index `debug_id` in errors.

maya: I'll draft the docs PR tomorrow and include the example responses + SDK mapping for `retry_after_ms` vs `retry_after`.

grace: Timeline? Want metrics in Console before we flip fallback-default policy globally.

samir: Goal: implement contract + telemetry in 2 weeks, docs + console in 3. Soft rollout to eu-west for canary this week. If canary looks OK, schedule global policy update in 4 weeks.

alex: Note for UX: keep KB links minimal. We'll map KB ids to nice human links in the Console so external customers see full KB. Internal staff get raw links in support tools.

ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0412 — track routing-fallback-error-ux (autotag: routing, api, telemetry)

samir: Thanks everyone. I'll open a short RFC with the taxonomy + example responses and tag owners. Action items in thread: samir/eli (taxonomy + runtime contract), grace (telemetry panels), maya (docs+SDK), alex (console banner), qa-bot (canary). :thumbsup:
